definitions.gloss: pheasant; specifically the green pheasant (Phasianus versicolor), Japan's national bird
definitions.explanation: A medium-sized ground bird native to Japan. The male has brilliant iridescent green and copper plumage. Designated as Japan's national bird in 1947.

examples.japanese: {雉|きじ}は{日本|にほん}の{国鳥|こくちょう}だ。
examples.english: The pheasant is Japan's national bird.

examples.japanese: {雄|おす}の{雉|きじ}は{色鮮|いろあざ}やかな{羽|はね}を{持|も}っている。
examples.english: Male pheasants have brilliantly colored feathers.

examples.japanese: {桃太郎|ももたろう}は{犬|いぬ}、{猿|さる}、{雉|きじ}を{家来|けらい}にして{鬼|おに}を{退治|たいじ}した。
examples.english: Momotaro defeated the demons with his retainers — a dog, a monkey, and a pheasant.

notes:
The {雉|きじ} (green pheasant) is endemic to Japan and was designated as the national bird in 1947. It is deeply embedded in Japanese culture and appears in many folk tales, proverbs, and idioms.

CULTURAL NOTE:
The pheasant is one of {桃太郎|ももたろう}'s three animal companions, along with the dog and monkey. This folk tale is known to virtually all Japanese people, making {雉|きじ} a culturally significant word.

PROVERBS AND IDIOMS:
- {雉|きじ}も{鳴|な}かずば{撃|う}たれまい: If the pheasant hadn't cried out, it wouldn't have been shot — keeping silent avoids trouble
- {頭隠|あたまかく}して{尻隠|しりかく}さず: hiding one's head but not one's tail — based on the pheasant's behavior of hiding its head in grass

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {国鳥|こくちょう}: national bird — the category; Japan's is the {雉|きじ}
- {鶏|にわとり}: chicken — a domesticated bird in the same family (Phasianidae)
- {鳩|はと}: pigeon/dove — another commonly seen bird in Japan
